title: Connector binary boots, loads config, and serves /metrics on loopback within 5 seconds
preconditions: A valid config.yaml and reachable CA chain
steps: Start the connector binary from a cold process start
expectedResult: The /metrics endpoint responds 200 with real Prometheus text within 5 seconds of process start.

title: vtec-management-service starts, connects to MongoDB, and its health check returns 200
preconditions: A reachable MongoDB and Vault instance configured via env
expectedResult: The service logs 'connected to MongoDB' and 'started', and /health returns 200.

title: A fresh checkout with no local config.yaml still boots to sane defaults
preconditions: A repo checkout with configs/config.yaml deleted
expectedResult: The connector boots using Load()'s built-in defaults (metrics_addr, cache paths, etc.) without crashing, and fails only on the genuinely-required tenant_id/license_key.

title: The /vtec sidebar item and fleet page load without a console error
preconditions: Logged in as a user with nav.vtec and vtec.read
expectedResult: Sidebar shows VTEC with Fleet/Workflows sub-items; clicking navigates to /vtec/fleet, which loads without an unhandled error in the browser console.

title: docker compose up brings up a running, healthy connector container with default Site A settings
expectedResult: The container starts, registers, and logs 'mTLS identity established' with no restart loop.

title: SIGTERM to the connector process triggers a graceful shutdown within the target time budget
preconditions: A running connector inside a real Linux container (SIGTERM semantics differ on native Windows)
steps: docker stop the running container with a 10s grace period
expectedResult: The container returns well under the grace period with a 'shutdown signal received, exiting' log line present, not a forced kill.
